summary: Taskand: complementary context, planner DSL and live user-twin observability

delivery.outcome: Preserve and reconcile the existing complementary runtime, document actual federation/privacy/publication gaps and add a read-only instance/process dashboard with measured registry radar. The user explicitly approved one recovery-only commit, ticket-branch push and draft PR of the existing snapshot despite failed governance. This exception covers the 129 preserved pending paths and bounded authorization/documentation updates, not new implementation. Main integration, release and deployment still require full governance and independent CI gates. Follow-up 2026-09-14 authorizes a local documentation-only dependency handoff plan. The user separately approved a new one-time migration contract for the 230 implementation files on a new branch, preserving history without force-push or bypassing tests and independent review. This documentation slice records that consent; it does not allocate or execute the successor migration, change current ticket budgets, or implement changes in other repositories.
nonGoals: Unreviewed merge, release or deployment; deleting unknown worktrees
Production website submissions or external network attacks
Inference of real human psychology or credentials
Implementation changes in doctor-agent or other repositories
Automatic discovery or scanning beyond explicitly configured peers
Reading browser, IDE or shell history without a scoped opt-in observer
VPS deployment without an explicit host and authorization

architecture.decision: Keep existing URI broker and twins; add owner-scoped versioned context at the trusted intake boundary, read-only graph projection, deterministic planner contract and local lease compatibility adapter. The user explicitly authorized takeover of both paused Taskand checkouts for lossless reconciliation into this existing ticket. Include the primary-only web twin changes and ignored public vault process metadata, retaining the verified archive of both staged and working layers. Do not increase delivery budgets or infer publication approval from this takeover.
